items.title: Galaxy VPN
items.subtitle: Android VPN client in Flutter
items.summary: An Android VPN app that finds the fastest free relay in each country and connects to it over SSTP or OpenVPN, through a native VpnService.
highlights: Live relay discovery: probes VPN Gate and VPNBook servers with a real handshake and lists the fastest one per country
SSTP tunnel written natively in Kotlin, with OpenVPN as a fallback over UDP 53 or TCP 443
Kill switch, auto-reconnect, IP rotation and a clear VPN permission disclosure
Clean architecture with Provider state and a tested VPN state machine

screens.alt: Home: one-tap connect and the fastest server
Relay servers by country, with live ping
Welcome: sign up, log in or continue as a guest
